cost_estimate: scaled from ledger-100 timing (15 min per 8192 atoms x 5 ns on H100): 8^3 runs about 15 min, 12^3 about 50 min, 16^3 about 2 h on H100, roughly twice on A40. K1 (38 runs) about 22 H100-hours; K2 (24 runs) 6 (box 8) or 20 (box 12) H100-hours

decision_rule.fail: any gate fails: the 300 K level stays carried from 700-1100 K; the K1 values are recorded as evidence about the equilibrium estimator; no factor change
decision_rule.not_affected: the 700-1100 K level (1.281), the law's composition shape outside 300 K, all SiGeC and SiC claims
decision_rule.pass: rho300(x) = kappa_GK(x, 300 K at box*) / kappa_law(x, 300) over x = 0.15, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.85 (each needs a qualifying point; if fewer than 5 qualify, branch fail). Let m = median rho300, cv = stdev/mean. (a) cv <= 0.15 and |m/1.281 - 1| <= 0.10: strengthen the ledger-90 level correction at 300 K and lift the 'carried' label. (b) cv <= 0.15 and |m/1.281 - 1| > 0.10: correct, a temperature-dependent level: factor m at 300 K and 1.281 at 700-1100 K, linear in T between 300 and 700 K, scope label 'level from equilibrium GK at 300 K and HNEMD at 700-1100 K, shape from rNEMD'. (c) cv > 0.15: downweight the law's composition shape at 300 K (scope label 'composition shape at 300 K disagrees with equilibrium GK'); no refit in this registration

gates.G_conv: at x = 0.15 and 0.85, the 12^3 point agrees with the 16^3 point
gates.G_meth: the GK point at x = 0.5, 700 K, 8^3 agrees with the size-free HNEMD reference (1.8656 +/- 0.1381 W/mK)
gates.G_plat: for every K1 point, the seed-mean running conductivity averaged over 75-100 ps agrees with that over 50-75 ps (same agreement rule, SE from seeds)
gates.box_star: if G_plat, G_meth and G_conv pass: box* = 8 if the 8^3 point also agrees with the 16^3 point at both x, else box* = 12. If any gate fails: no box*, K2 is not run

protocol.engine: GPUMD (CHPC build, gpumd_v2/GPUMD), equilibrium MD, compute_hac
protocol.kappa_run: hac.out running conductivity columns: kx = kxi + kxo, ky = kyi + kyo, kz; kappa_run(t) = (kx + ky + kz) / 3
protocol.placement: execution detail: grn061 (granite sparks-gpu-grn, H100) when no sparks-partition job runs there, otherwise notchpeak-gpu-guest A40 (--gres=gpu:a40:1); moving between them needs only a placement note
protocol.preemption: requeue, restart from scratch with the same seed (declared, not a deviation)
protocol.readout: kappa_run = mean of kappa_run(t) over the window 50-100 ps
protocol.run_in: npt_ber 100 ps, nvt_nhc 50 ps, then nve with compute_hac 10 10000 10 for 10 ns, dump_thermo 10000, time step 1 fs (HAC sampled every 10 fs to 100 ps correlation time)
stage_order: K2-box<box*> (only the box K1 selects is built and run)

question: What is the box-converged equilibrium Green-Kubo 300 K conductivity of Tersoff-1989 SiGe across x = 0.15-0.85, and does its level agree with the factor 1.281 carried from 700-1100 K?
run_gates: R1: exit 0 and hac.out has 1000 rows; R2: mean NVE temperature within 3% of target (all thermo.out rows; dump_thermo covers only the NVE production); R3: 0 < kappa_run < 2000 W/mK
why: ledger 101: in Tersoff SiGe at 300 K the longest HNEMD cells (48x8x8) ran away or failed the drift gate, so no box length could be selected. The reading recorded there was that long-wavelength modes respond nonlinearly to the driving force. Equilibrium Green-Kubo measures the same conductivity from heat-current fluctuations with no driving force.
